outputs.explanation: Panel A is a stacked area/bar plot showing median promoter-state frequencies across many continuous bins of Pol II ChIP-seq signal (essentially a trend plot analogous to a line plot). Overlaying thousands of individual promoter values on a stacked, continuously-binned representation would not be meaningful or readable, so this plot type is exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

Panel B is a single-molecule stack plot in which every row represents one individual DNA molecule's methylation pattern; the aggregated state-frequency sidebar is a direct summary of these individually displayed molecules, so individual data points (molecules) are already fully shown.
Same representation as panel A (mouse data): a stacked, continuously-binned median-frequency plot across Pol II ChIP-seq levels, which is exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
Same representation as panel B (mouse Skp1 locus): each row is an individual molecule, so individual-level data are already displayed alongside the summary sidebar.

Panel E is a box plot, which already displays the distribution (median, IQR, whiskers) and additionally shows outlier points; box plots are exempt from the requirement to overlay all individual data points.

Panel F is a box plot, which already displays the distribution (median, IQR, whiskers) and additionally shows outlier points; box plots are exempt from the requirement to overlay all individual data points.
